title: ctenitis biformis
intro: Ctenitis biformis, commonly known as the Two-formed Fern or Two-Formed Ctenitis, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation and the improvement of cardiovascular health, attributed to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis biformis are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective effects. Further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties of Ctenitis biformis, but its potential uses in traditional medicine are promising.
